text:
maria_l: Kicking off account/project + VNet scaffold for az-5 region. Goal: get a minimal Dedicated GPU pool + peering to prod-core, validate networking/security, and hand off to oncall when green. Posting checklist and next steps here.

kevin_g: Thanks. Quick checklist draft: subscription + resource group, VNet + subnets, transit subnet for peering, route tables, NSGs, service principal, quota requests for GPUs/cores, terraform module, smoke deploy.

anya: I can create the subscription and RGs. Need confirmed billing account and the org unit to attach. Tagging policy we'll enforce at creation (team,env,cost_center).

cjordan: GPU plan: request A100-40GB quota but start with 4 nodes (scale to 8 after validation). Also request additional public IP quota (we use NAT for egress but need a few IPs for testing).

maria_l: Agree on starting smaller. Samira, can you post a rough daily cost delta for 4x A100 vs 8x? We need that for approval.

samira: 4x A100 ~ ~$1,200/day (ballpark), 8x ~ ~$2,300/day. I'll upload a precise calc to the finance doc. Recommend reserved vs on-demand discussion later.

kevin_g: VNet addressing proposal: prod vnet 10.50.0.0/16, dev vnet 10.51.0.0/16, transit/peering subnet 10.250.5.0/24. Keep deterministic /16s so future regions map easily.

kevin_g: Example azure cli to bootstrap RG + VNet:
```
az group create -n rg-az5-prod -l westeurope
az network vnet create -g rg-az5-prod -n vnet-az5-prod --address-prefixes 10.50.0.0/16
az network vnet subnet create -g rg-az5-prod --vnet-name vnet-az5-prod -n subnet-transit --address-prefixes 10.250.5.0/24
```

anya: We'll also create a service principal for the infra pipeline with least privilege. Naming: sp-infra-az5. Tags: team:infrastructure, cost_center:ml, env:prod.

cjordan: Quota request steps (Azure): open support request -> subscription -> Quota -> GPU SKU and cores. Use this link in portal: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade. Include subscription id, region (westeurope), SKU (Standard_ND96asr_v4 or A100 equivalent), requested cores, justification (inference fleet for Redwood Dedicated).

maria_l: Validation checklist before handoff (must be green):
- VNet and subnets created and tagged
- VNet peered to prod-core (transit path verified)
- Route tables configured for transit subnet
- NSG applied to GPU subnets with appropriate ports (ssh restricted, kube ports allowed)
- Service principal created and creds in vault
- Private endpoint for container registry + ACR firewall rules
- GPU quota approved and visible in portal
- Terraform plan applied and committed to infra repo
- Cost tags applied to RGs and resources

sre-oncall: Add a small smoke deploy step: create a test nodepool with 1 GPU and run perf/smoke: ./tools/gpu-smoke.sh. Capture logs to S3 and post sample output here. Also add runbook link for remediation.

maria_l: I'll run the smoke test once the nodepool is up. Plan to do a canary inference request and validate kv-cache warmup and latency < 120ms for short prompts.

samira: Cost controls: recommend autoscale min=1, max=8 for initial stage with a scale-down grace period of 30m. Add budget alert on subscription at 25%/50%/75% of monthly allocation.

kevin_g: Terraform note: I pushed an initial module to git: https://git.redwood/infra/regions/az5 branch=az5-networking. Please review IAM bindings and peering resource. Example peering snippet in tf:
```
resource "azurerm_virtual_network_peering" "prod-to-core" {
  name                      = "prod-to-core"
  resource_group_name       = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  virtual_network_name      = azurerm_virtual_network.prod.name
  remote_virtual_network_id = var.prod_core_vnet_id
  allow_forwarded_traffic   = true
  allow_virtual_network_access = true
}
```

infra-bot: Reminder: create support ticket template named "Quota increase AZ5 GPUs" and add it to ops/playbooks.

anya: I'll create the SP and push initial TF vars. Will coordinate with security for the least-privilege review.

cjordan: Also double-check network security appliance limits for peering routes; some transit appliances have limits per region. If limits are tight, we'll use BGP peering via hub.

maria_l: Handoff plan: once checklist green, 16:00 UTC quick sync (15m) + post handoff message to #eng-oncall. I'm owner through validation.

sre-oncall: ACK — I'll own post-handoff health checks for 24h, will enable extra alerting on GPU OOMs and kube scheduling failures.

anya: Done: created RG skeleton and pushed tags to branch az5-init. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/az5-init.

samira: Uploaded rough cost spreadsheet to finance folder (internal link). Will refine after quota confirmation.

maria_l: Great work. Please drop any errors/logs here. If quota request stalls >24h escalate to infra leads. :thumbsup:
